title: Airmid Éireann: Ireland's Open Pharma Data Project
description:
Airmid Éireann is the open-data project of Priya Life Science. It collects public records on medicines, clinical trials, approvals, shortages, safety, trade, spending and research for Ireland, compared with Europe and the world from official publishers, checks them, and releases them as CSV and JSON with each source's licence, a data dictionary, checksums and DCAT-AP metadata.

This software release contains the collectors and release builder. The data release of 2026-10-21 holds 67 datasets and 1,735,033 records, refreshed weekly at priyalifescience.com/opendata/airmid/v1 (index: catalog.json; search: search by meaning).

Clinical trials

  • ClinicalTrials.gov: studies with a site in Ireland: 2,699 records (U.S. National Library of Medicine)
  • ClinicalTrials.gov: studies with a site in Europe, started 2015 or later: 113,437 records (U.S. National Library of Medicine)

Medicines and approvals

  • HPRA: human medicines authorised in Ireland: 10,290 records (Health Products Regulatory Authority)
  • EMA: human medicines evaluated by the European Medicines Agency: 2,357 records (European Medicines Agency)
  • EMA: EU orphan designations: 3,310 records (European Medicines Agency)
  • EU orphan market exclusivity (Union Register of medicinal products): 369 records (European Commission)
  • EMA: medicines granted PRIME eligibility (current and previous): 177 records (European Medicines Agency)
  • EMA: decisions on paediatric investigation plans (PIPs) and waivers: 3,394 records (European Medicines Agency)
  • US FDA: original approvals, all years (Drugs@FDA): 25,405 records (U.S. Food and Drug Administration)
  • US FDA Orange Book: drug patents and exclusivities: 24,785 records (U.S. Food and Drug Administration)
  • US FDA Purple Book: licensed biological products and exclusivity: 2,251 records (U.S. Food and Drug Administration)
  • Health Canada: New Drug Submission approvals since 2016: 1,061 records (Health Canada)
  • Health Canada Drug Product Database: human drug products (all DINs): 51,123 records (Health Canada)
  • US NLM DailyMed: index of human prescription drug labels (SPL metadata): 52,388 records (U.S. National Library of Medicine)

Shortages and safety

  • EMA: medicine shortages (human): 85 records (European Medicines Agency)
  • US FDA: drug shortages: 1,581 records (U.S. Food and Drug Administration)
  • EMA: referral procedures for human medicines: 461 records (European Medicines Agency)
  • EMA: periodic safety update single assessment (PSUSA) outcomes: 2,735 records (European Medicines Agency)
  • MHRA (UK): drug and device alerts and Drug Safety Update: 2,323 records (Medicines and Healthcare products Regulatory Agency)
  • US FDA: medical device recalls since 2018: 23,868 records (U.S. Food and Drug Administration)
  • US FDA: warning letters about human drugs, biologics and medical devices (2021 onwards): 1,729 records (U.S. Food and Drug Administration)
  • US FDA FAERS: adverse event report counts by year and drug (aggregate): 1,212 records (U.S. Food and Drug Administration)
  • ECDC ESAC-Net: antimicrobial consumption by EU/EEA country, sector, ATC group and year (Annual Epidemiological Report 2022, downloadable tables D1-D24): 6,192 records (European Centre for Disease Prevention and Control)

Industry, trade and spending

  • CSO: Irish exports of medicinal and pharmaceutical products by country (TSM10): 6,860 records (Central Statistics Office)
  • CSO: Irish pharmaceutical industry statistics (NACE 21): production indices, earnings, Census of Industrial Production, Pharmaceutical and Medical Manufacturing series: 1,905 records (Central Statistics Office)
  • Eurostat: EU member states' trade in medicinal and pharmaceutical products (SITC 54), by partner: 207,276 records (Eurostat)
  • Eurostat: pharmaceutical manufacturing industry (NACE C21) by country: enterprises, employment, turnover, value added, production index: 32,436 records (Eurostat)
  • OECD Health Statistics: pharmaceutical spending by country (System of Health Accounts): 70,802 records (OECD)
  • NHS England Prescription Cost Analysis: monthly items and cost by BNF chemical substance: 115,814 records (NHS Business Services Authority)
  • US Medicaid State Drug Utilization Data: national prescriptions and amounts reimbursed by NDC product and year: 76,111 records (Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services)
  • US CMS: NADAC drug acquisition costs (latest weekly file, one row per NDC): 30,031 records (U.S. Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services)
  • Pharma, biotech and medtech companies relevant to Ireland: identifier crosswalk (Wikidata, LEI, CRO number): 100 records (Wikidata)
  • EPA Ireland: industrial emissions (IE), IPPC and IPC licences for pharmaceutical manufacturing: 52 records (Environmental Protection Agency)
  • EEA Industrial Reporting (E-PRTR): pollutant releases and waste transfers of Irish chemical and pharmaceutical facilities: 19,871 records (European Environment Agency)

Health services and research

  • NTPF: Irish public hospital waiting lists (outpatient, inpatient/day case, GI endoscopy), latest 24 monthly snapshots: 9,924 records (National Treatment Purchase Fund)
  • CORDIS: EU-funded health, medicine, pharma and biotech research projects (Horizon 2020 and Horizon Europe): 14,111 records (European Commission / Publications Office of the European Union)
  • OpenAlex: Irish-affiliated research in pharmacology, pharmaceutics, toxicology and drug discovery (2015 onwards): 4,302 records (OurResearch)
  • OpenAlex: European-affiliated research (EU-27, UK, Norway, Switzerland) in pharmacology, pharmaceutics, toxicology and drug discovery (2023 onwards): 86,168 records (OurResearch)
  • NIH RePORTER: US NIH awards to organisations in Ireland: 21 records (U.S. National Institutes of Health)
  • Research Ireland (formerly Science Foundation Ireland): research grant commitments, 2000 to the latest published file (Irish Research Council grants not included): 8,475 records (Taighde Éireann – Research Ireland)

Irish health system, public spending and parliament

  • CSO: System of Health Accounts for Ireland: current health care expenditure by function, provider and financing scheme: 13,706 records (Central Statistics Office)
  • Department of Health / HSE: hospital discharge summary statistics (HIPE): discharges, bed days, length of stay and standardised rates by diagnosis, procedure, age, sex and county: 111,352 records (Department of Health)
  • Department of Health: Health in Ireland Key Trends tables on medicines, prescribing, health spending, eligibility schemes and the hospital workforce: 1,350 records (Department of Health)
  • Northern Ireland GP prescribing: monthly items and cost by BNF chemical substance and formulation: 86,689 records (Business Services Organisation)
  • eTenders (Ireland): public procurement notices and contract awards in health, medicines and medical technology, 2013 onwards: 6,914 records (Office of Government Procurement)
  • Oireachtas: parliamentary questions on medicines, drugs, pharmaceuticals and the HPRA (Health and Enterprise), 2020 onward: 10,323 records (Houses of the Oireachtas)

European national registers, prices and use

  • France: medicines and presentations on the public medicines database (BDPM), with prices, reimbursement rates and MITM ATC codes: 22,159 records (Base de données publique des médicaments)
  • France: active substances and dosages of every medicine on the public medicines database (BDPM): 32,439 records (Base de données publique des médicaments)
  • France: HAS Transparency Committee SMR and ASMR ratings of medicines since 2002 (BDPM): 25,664 records (Base de données publique des médicaments)
  • France: ANSM medicine availability notices (stock-outs, supply tensions, withdrawals) from the BDPM: 710 records (Base de données publique des médicaments)
  • France: reimbursed medicines dispensed in community pharmacies, national totals by year and ATC5 or CIP13 (Open Medic): 68,898 records (Caisse nationale de l'Assurance Maladie)
  • Netherlands: outpatient medicine use and cost per ATC code and year under the Zvw (GIPdatabank): 17,795 records (Zorginstituut Nederland)
  • Italy (AIFA): medicines reimbursed by the national health service, Class A (community) and Class H (hospital) lists, with prices and ATC codes: 13,210 records (Agenzia Italiana del Farmaco)
  • Italy (AIFA): medicines temporarily in shortage (Lista dei farmaci temporaneamente carenti): 2,501 records (Agenzia Italiana del Farmaco)
  • Italy (AIFA): clinical trials of medicines in the national observatory OsSC (ongoing, concluded, not approved or withdrawn), with participating centres, 2018 to January 2025: 3,330 records (Agenzia Italiana del Farmaco)
  • Italy (AIFA): authorised manufacturing sites for medicines, medical gases and active substances (Officine autorizzate), by town and region: 693 records (Agenzia Italiana del Farmaco)
  • Italy (AIFA): national medicines spending and packs by reimbursement class and ATC (4th level), community pharmacies and direct purchases, per year from 2016: 10,751 records (Agenzia Italiana del Farmaco)
  • Scotland community prescribing: monthly items and cost by BNF chemical substance: 65,711 records (Public Health Scotland)
  • Finland: Fimea basic register of human medicinal products (with ATC and substitution groups) and medicine shortage notices: 28,683 records (Fimea)
  • Norway: FEST medicine packages with ATC, pharmacy prices, reimbursement and substitution groups: 10,817 records (Direktoratet for medisinske produkter)

Ireland in the world

  • US FDA: drug recalls (enforcement reports), all years: 18,042 records (U.S. Food and Drug Administration)
  • US FDA: National Drug Code Directory (prescription, biological and unfinished drug products): 78,961 records (U.S. Food and Drug Administration)
  • Health Canada Recalls and Safety Alerts: health products (drugs, natural health products, biologics, medical devices): 13,304 records (Health Canada)
  • Health Canada Notice of Compliance database: all human-medicine NOCs since 1994 (NDS, SNDS, ANDS, SANDS): 23,652 records (Health Canada)
  • Singapore HSA: Listing of Registered Therapeutic Products, with manufacturer and country of manufacture: 5,511 records (Health Sciences Authority)
  • PHARMAC Pharmaceutical Schedule (New Zealand): funded packs with subsidy, price and restrictions, latest monthly edition: 2,507 records (PHARMAC)
  • World Bank World Development Indicators: health spending, population, life expectancy, GDP per capita and high-tech exports, all countries, 2000 onwards: 41,870 records (The World Bank)

No personal names or contact details are published. The data have multiple licences: each dataset keeps the licence of its source (listed in catalog.json and each datapackage.json); they are not all CC BY 4.0. This software is EUPL-1.2. Not medical advice. Project page: priyalifescience.com/airmed.
